stories.title: Bills open new stadium with impressive performance over Lions
stories.summary: Josh Allen accounted for five touchdowns as Buffalo moved to 2-0 in their home opener.

stories.title: LSU upgrades QB Leavitt to questionable for showdown with Ole Miss
stories.summary: LSU quarterback Sam Leavitt has been upgraded from doubtful to questionable for Saturday's primetime rivalry game vs. Ole Miss in Oxford, Mississippi.

stories.title: Mets' Young has concussion symptoms, CT scan negative after scary collision
stories.summary: Mets first baseman Jared Young was carted off the field in the sixth inning Thursday night after he was knocked out when struck on the head by a knee from pitcher Nolan McLean as the two converged on a slow grounder. A CT scan at a hospital was negative.

stories.title: DC Belichick resigns as UNC investigation finds disregard for conduct
stories.summary: North Carolina DC Steve Belichick has resigned as the university's probe into the football program's culture and climate found "isolated" disregard for standards of conduct.

stories.title: McVay says Rams 'hopeful' Donald will play vs. Giants on MNF
stories.summary: Rams defensive tackle Aaron Donald will practice in full Thursday and the team is "hopeful" he will play Monday night against the Giants, coach Sean McVay said.
